title: 蒼穹の爪
caption: soaring boss song, wide sweeping strings and brass over fast drum and bass, rushing wind, diving synth risers, majestic chorus, oceanic liquid pads, waves, wide stereo, sea breeze, floating city, female duet, a powerful husky rock diva and a bright high sweet girl trading lines, Japanese lyrics, Japanese anime song, J-pop royal road progression, bittersweet melancholic yet uplifting, sorrowful piano and strings fused with breakbeat groove, ethereal reverb, upfront vocal
lyrics:
[Intro - rushing wind and strings]

[Verse 1]
海の上を 巨大な翼が渡る
太陽を背に 鋼の影が回る
風を切り裂き 爪が光る
見上げた空が 戦場になる

[Pre-Chorus]
急降下の 音が来る
息を止めずに 前へ走る

[Chorus]
羽ばたけ 蒼い空の果てまで
怯まず 叫べ 嵐の中で
落ちてくる爪を かわしたら
翼を撃ち抜け 今だから

[Instrumental Break - soaring strings and drum and bass]

[Chorus]
羽ばたけ 蒼い空の果てまで
怯まず 叫べ 嵐の中で
落ちてくる爪を かわしたら
翼を撃ち抜け 今だから

[Outro - wind]
